company.name: JTS Logistics Inc
company.description: JTS Logistics Inc is the leading and fast growing logistics company in the Midwest. JTS Logistics operates as a 100% Owner Operator company, meaning it does not own any trucks, but rather possesses equipment such as Dry Vans, Flat Beds, and reefers. We are a trucking company dedicated to professionalism, dependable service, customized solutions, cutting-edge tracking technology, and the highest quality service for clients.
